**Lamina 0.4.0 is out!** 🎉

It has new things, but most of my work went into the app itself. Every setting has help and a clear name, and a tour shows each part of the page. And I gave the 3D printer some love: it is now a machine of its own in Lamina, not only for prototypes.

**A new way to build: band lattice.** Rings across the model that slot together, like a woven ball. The video shows a sphere going together.

**Paper lamps.** Close the windows of a lamp with paper, or with a thin printed layer. The new example is a lantern of twelve dodecahedra.

**Make a mask.** Select the faces you do not want, and the rest unfolds into panels.

**Light your model.** Tick *light* and a bulb lights it from inside, with its shadows on the walls.

**Printed panels join without glue.** A tooth that clicks under a bar, or a printed clip that slides along a short wall on each panel.

**Pick your machine first.** Laser, CNC router, 3D printer, or laser + 3D printer, at the top of *Sheet & fit*. Lamina then shows the settings that machine needs. A 3D printer gets a print set: every part with its number and its print settings.

**Your projects in a library.** *library* in the top bar keeps every saved project and each revision of it.

Everything new, with a picture for each: *help* → *What is new*.
New to Lamina? *help* → *Tour of the page*, and the step-by-step guides: <https://marcelfarres.github.io/lamina/?ref=discord-0.4.0#guides>

Try it: <https://marcelfarres.github.io/lamina/app/?ref=discord-0.4.0>

What will you make first?
